gbm_population_evidence.quote: progressive GBM based on the RANO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: [PROCEDURE] Skullremodeling surgery (other names: SR-surgery): Strategically placed cranial burrholes in order to improve the TTField "dose" focally in the tumor.
[OTHER] Control: Tumor treating fields combined with best medical treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Enhancing Tumor Treating Fields for Recurrent Glioblastoma With Targeted and Individualised Skullremodeling Surgery: A Multi-center Randomized Phase 2 Trial

coder_notes: Interventions are skull-remodelling surgery and TTFields (device) plus unspecified best-practice medical oncological treatment (physician's choice, e.g. bevacizumab or temozolomide rechallenge mentioned only for the earlier phase 1 trial). No drug is a registered intervention or stated as received by every patient, so no agents listed. Registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm is the control.
